name: Contract bridge
summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game where pairs bid to set a contract then try to make it.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships are dealt 13 cards each from a 52-card deck. An auction proceeds clockwise: each player may pass, double, redouble or bid a level from 1 to 7 plus a denomination (clubs, diamonds, hearts, spades, notrump) higher than the last bid. Three consecutive passes end the auction; the highest bid becomes the contract, with six added to its level as tricks required, and its bidder's partnership as declaring side. The player left of declarer leads first; dummy's hand is then faced. Players must follow the led suit if possible, otherwise may play any card. Highest card of led suit wins unless trumped, when highest trump wins. Declarer controls dummy as well as own cards. Defenders try to defeat the contract. Points are scored for tricks made, overtricks, undertricks, bonuses for game, slam, doubled, based on vulnerability and denomination.
rating_reason: Specific trick-taking card game with bidding and hidden information.
